author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Superheroes are supposed to save us.

So what happens when the most powerful hero in the world…simply doesn’t care?  What happens when a superhero realizes he doesn't have to pretend anymore?

In The Boys, Homelander isn’t just another evil Superman parody, he’s something much more unsettling. He's a man with godlike power, a manufactured image, and absolutely no moral foundation to hold it all together.  Homelander is, for all intents and purposes, Evil Superman.

But what makes Homelander truly terrifying isn’t just his strength…It’s the fact that he genuinely believes he’s the hero.

title: The Insane Psychology Behind Homelander
